dashboard.label: AD Account Review (SecOps)
dashboard.description: Periodic review of Active Directory accounts by the SecOps team: every account gets a risk score and the reasons why it should be reviewed (privileged, password never expires, stale, expired, SPN with old password, delegation, disabled but still privileged...), plus review status and owner information. Filter by OU, scope, review status and risk, export the list for account owners, and record decisions in adx_review_decisions.csv. Based on the AD Objects lookups (last refresh, not live LDAP).
